new_behavior: allow only explicitly reopened matching rejected decisions with reopen_condition and reopen_reason
non_goals: do not rewrite rejected decision history
do not infer reopen_condition satisfaction from natural language
do not bypass exact config hash duplicate blocking
acceptance: route check without reopen remains BLOCKED for matching rejected decisions
route check with matching --reopen-decision and --reopen-reason returns ALLOWED_WITH_REOPEN
failed exact config duplicates can reopen only when they are evidence for the explicitly reopened rejected decision
unmatched, missing-reason, or no-reopen-condition cases fail closed
route_checks table records reopened decision ids and reopen reason
